dataset: ATKIS DGM1 bare-earth, bounded8m WCS export stored in integer metres; scenery only
method: Bilinear numeric sampling of the bounded bare-earth export onto the existing scenery lattice in the original scene frame. Grid materialization composes current/source scale into XY only. Common exact road minimum is subtracted; no median rebase or vertical rescale.±.5 m integer quantization is additional to±.15 m provider accuracy. High-precision DGM025 road/camber observations remain independent.
